title: The silk river screen
alt: An embroidered silk landscape hangs from a wooden rail, with a blue river, layered mountains and red pavilions.
description: A richly layered landscape rendered in silk thread, with coherent architecture and intricate tactile detail.
prompt: A breathtaking wide Chinese silk tapestry displayed as a complete wall hanging. A continuous blue-green river winds between layered mountains, terraced villages and delicate pine forests; tiny red-roofed pavilions, arched bridges and gold-thread clouds create intricate detail. Visible embroidered satin stitches, couched gold thread and subtle silk sheen; the scenery is fully made of thread, not printed. A slim dark wooden rail holds the top and a plain woven border surrounds the artwork. Refined museum photography, softly lit ivory wall, no people, no writing.
